exposure: Surgical TAP block with Bupivacaine alone
Surgical TAP block with Bupivacaine plus dexamethasone
cohort: The study included 100 women undergoing caesarean section.
finding: Surgical TAP block with bupivacaine plus dexamethasone was more effective in prolonging postoperative analgesia compared to bupivacaine alone.
followup_time: Approximately 8 hours (466.8 minutes) post-operation for analgesia duration.
